title: Diamond Head, Waikiki Beach Honolulu Hawaii - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A soft-focus mid-century snapshot capturing the iconic volcanic profile of Diamond Head (Lēʻahi) rising above the tranquil waters of Waikiki Beach in Honolulu, Hawaii. Silhouetted beachgoers and swimmers dot the gentle surf, while the sandy foreground features a small beach umbrella or tether post. Post-war tourism to the Hawaiian Islands boomed during this period as air travel became more accessible, cementing Waikiki as a quintessential tropical paradise destination.
